text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush Ines Fujin to the infirmary as she's suffered an injury during training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I kind of messed up there. Guess I won't be making my shift today…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I really don't want to skip out on training…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, um, I think I can grit my teeth through the pain, so can we have just a light training session?
choice_data_list: Okay, let's do what we can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I guess that's for the best. It'd be a real problem if this injury got any worse…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, I get it. I'll rest up today so I can recover as soon as possible…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Disappointed, Ines Fujin returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks! All right, let's get in as much training as we can handle!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I barely even put any weight on it and it's killing me…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We just started training, and I'm already done…
choice_data_list: Maybe it's best if you keep the moving to a minimum.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, maybe… Okay, I'll just take it easy today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frustrated, Ines Fujin returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew. I think I can handle this level of exercise.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If I keep this up until my injury heals, I won't have to worry about getting rusty. What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While monitoring her injury, Ines Fujin completes a light training session.
